llm_findings: The proposed flag is inert under the pinned control configuration. Authoritative train.py lines 4178–4193 set USE_COMPILE_MUON = True; lines 5818–5833 resolve --compile-muon to True unless NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_COMPILE_MUON is '0'. Neither pinned control environment supplies that override. Adding --compile-muon therefore introduces no causal change.

The proposal's own pre-full condition is already satisfied by the supplied source evidence: classify FALSIFIED-INERT and do not proceed to the full run. This comparison cannot test eager-versus-compiled throughput because both arms use compiled Muon.

The implementation description also overstates the evidence: the flag compiles Muon's per-group math body, not necessarily the entire optimizer update into one graph. The adjacent source comment already documents compiled BF16 numerical drift, so numerical equivalence is not established by a smoke BPB comparison.

The optimization category is competition-legal and the supplied decision log does not close this isolated flag experiment, but those checks do not remedy the absence of a treatment/control difference.
